gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-tc: Noto Sans TC reads open and friendly, with tall, generous curves. Audiowide sits above it in tile-like, uniform-stroke letters, so a longer passage underneath feels like a plain sans settling in after a loud, futuristic header.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-malayalam: Eater has thin strokes that are clearly lighter than its stems yet never fragile, spaced with wide gaps. And Noto Sans Malayalam answers with a dense, middle-heavy texture and a generous s, which is the pair's sharpest quality.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Ornate and literary, Almendra Display lets its tall x-height and never-pinched letters do the talking. And Noto Sans Telugu carries a longer passage with a high midline and counters open to the outside, so the text keeps moving.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-mandaic: Dark, jagged and spaced wide, Eater snarls at the top of the page while Noto Sans Mandaic loosens up below. Its curvy lowercase rising near capital height is the strongest thing here.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-thai: Almendra Display brings ornate, literary letters that never seem to pinch shut. But Noto Sans Thai is the real surprise, its lowercase swollen like inflated glass beads, round and open beside that heading.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-thai-looped: Futuristic tiles, then tall bold-looking lowercase. Audiowide sets glyphs apart with wide grout-like gaps, and Noto Sans Thai Looped sits beneath with spacious curve terminals that make the display lettering feel even sharper.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-marchen: Eater arrives dark and aggressive, its weight shifting gradually rather than snapping, with short ascenders and wide gaps between letters. Noto Sans Marchen below, a plain sans with proud small letters, reads cleanly.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-tifina: Ornate to the core, Almendra Display keeps its letters from ever pinching shut. Noto Sans Tifinagh fills each line with rounded, inflated lowercase bowls, a plain sans that would swamp the heading if it were made large.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-tirhuta: Audiowide holds its stroke weight absolutely constant, giving the heading a futuristic, tile-like stamp. But Noto Sans Tirhuta does the quieter job, with a dominant x-height and cut-back terminals that leave a clear gap.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-medefaidrin: Noto Sans Medefaidrin reads professionally, its lowercase rising high and its curves turning in without ink pooling. Give that sans-serif a generous size, and let Eater stay as it is.
